## Pooled vs Per-Battery Oblimin Loadings (Item by Item)

Pooled: one 3-factor oblimin EFA on all 36 items (N = 1258 complete cases), which gives one row per item-battery. Pooled-W and Pooled-S are the pooled loadings on the item's weak-tie and strong-tie rows. Weak and Strong are separate 3-factor oblimin EFAs on each battery. V, L, and C are variety, liberal, and conservative, labeled by the script 01 anchor items. Rows are sorted by pooled-W variety.
